principle: Published tariff labels are financial identities. Exact labels are accepted; aliases require explicit review. Similar spelling, proximity, shared estate names, hotel names, or inferred geography never establish fare identity.

acceptedSourceNormalizations.reason: Explicit source-heading normalization; does not authorize fuzzy matching.

reviewFlags: Source labels that appear typographically unusual (for example Farsham, Sally's Fancy, Ham's Bay/Clover Crest, Ham's Bay/Clover Guard) remain literal published identities until separately reviewed.
Hotel/business labels do not automatically collapse into an estate or neighborhood with a similar name.
Slash and parenthetical qualifiers are financially significant unless a reviewed mapping explicitly proves equivalence.
certificationRule: canonicalEndpointAuditComplete may become true only when every activated STX row resolves through exact published identity or an explicit reviewed alias and all protected distinctions are covered by negative tests.
